entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Ack... We're just tryin' to get outta the[n]rain, but look how crowded it is...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I guess everyone had the same idea...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: What's up?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mm, I think I just saw someone I know...

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You mean the girl in that black car?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, she's got a ride...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Time to show your skills, Mona![n]We need you as a car!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: It's not possible in the real world!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: My feet hurt... It's cold... The festival's[n]been canceled... This sucks...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We made such a commotion with the[n]public, and this is what we get? Laaame.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Aren't heroes that lurk in the shadows[n]boring?
That's how it should be.
Yeah...
I like the shade.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: So that's what makes us cool?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: To be honest, I'm not a fan...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What are you, moss!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I wanna change the world with a loud[n]bang, like a huge firework!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Then again, we aren't gonna find[n]someone bigger than Kaneshiro that easily.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The rain is letting up. Though it's[n]regrettable, we should go our[n]separate ways for today.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Yeah. Let's go home.
